description: Eclipse Proving is governed bench access for agents: physical bench authority exercised only inside a Herald-signed mandate binding agent identity x board identity x operation classes x exact artifact hashes, enforced at the bridge holding the JTAG/serial/power connections, with every session — including gaps and refusals — sealed into a Blackbox-form evidence pack verifiable offline. One-byte rule: an artifact one byte off its Herald-pinned hash refuses ARTIFACT_PIN_MISMATCH, receipted, no override. Tiers T0 read / T1 volatile write (pin-gated) / T2 power (every act receipted, dead-man rule) / T3 persistent write (owner-armed per board per session + mandatory pre-write capture + recorded recovery path). Permanent refusals with no tool and no path around: security-fuse programming, PMIC/voltage configuration, boot-mode strap changes. P0 targets are fixture + emulator class only (AMD QEMU Xilinx fork ZCU102, owner-confirmed 2026-10-25; Renode diversity); HwServerAdapter is a P1-only stub.
